title: Water Damage Mitigation Tear-Out and Flooring Price List
content:
Water Damage Mitigation tear-out work is priced per linear foot for drywall and baseboard and per square foot for carpet and pad. Each tier also states whether wet carpet and wet carpet pad may be salvaged. All six tiers are listed.

| Tier | Flood cut per lf | Baseboard removal per lf | Pad removal per sq ft | Carpet removal per sq ft | Carpet detach and reset per sq ft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $2.85 | $1.12 | $0.48 | $0.42 | $0.71 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $2.57 | $1.01 | $0.43 | $0.38 | $0.64 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $2.85 | $1.12 | $0.48 | $0.42 | $0.71 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $2.57 | $1.01 | $0.43 | $0.38 | $0.64 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $3.40 | $1.12 | $0.58 | $0.52 | $0.71 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $3.06 | $1.01 | $0.52 | $0.47 | $0.64 |

| Tier | Carpet salvage allowed | Carpet pad salvage allowed |
|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | Yes | Yes |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | Yes | Yes |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | Yes | No |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | Yes | No |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | No | No |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | No | No |

## Definitions
- **Flood cut**: Flood cut of drywall per linear foot, USD.
- **Baseboard removal**: Baseboard detach (and bag for reset) per linear foot, USD.
- **Pad removal**: Carpet pad tear-out and bagging per square foot, USD.
- **Carpet removal**: Carpet tear-out and disposal per square foot, USD.
- **Carpet detach and reset**: Carpet detach, float-dry and reset per square foot, USD.
- **Carpet salvage allowed**: Whether wet carpet may be dried in place / detached and reset instead of discarded, boolean.
- **Carpet pad salvage allowed**: Whether wet carpet pad may be dried in place instead of discarded, boolean.

## Salvage settings at a glance
| Water category | Carpet | Carpet pad |
|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation tiers | may be salvaged | may be salvaged |
| Gray Water Mitigation tiers | may be salvaged | may not be salvaged |
| Black Water Mitigation tiers | may not be salvaged | may not be salvaged |
